description: This file defines the PermissionRepository class which implements permission-related data access methods for a system, including user memberships, role permissions, resource permissions, and team permission queries, using Prisma ORM and raw SQL queries.

classes.name: PermissionRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing permissions, including user memberships, role permissions, resource permissions, and team permission checks.

methods.name: getUserMemberships
methods.description: Retrieves all team memberships for a user and maps them to domain permissions.

methods.name: getMembershipByMembershipId
methods.description: Fetches a specific membership by its ID, including team parent info.

methods.name: getMembershipByUserAndTeam
methods.description: Fetches a user's membership for a specific team.

methods.name: getOrgMembership
methods.description: Fetches a user's membership within an organization.

methods.name: checkRolePermission
methods.description: Checks if a role has a specific permission.

methods.name: checkRolePermissions
methods.description: Checks if a role has all specified permissions.

methods.name: getResourcePermissions
methods.description: Gets permissions for a user on a specific resource within a team.

methods.name: getResourcePermissionsByRoleId
methods.description: Gets permissions associated with a role for a specific resource.

methods.name: getTeamIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves team IDs where a user has a specific permission.

methods.name: getTeamIdsWithPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves team IDs where a user has any of a list of permissions.

methods.name: getTeamsWithPBACPermissions
methods.description: Internal method to find teams with PBAC permissions based on role permissions.

methods.name: getTeamsWithFallbackRoles
methods.description: Internal method to find teams where user has fallback roles, PBAC disabled.
